name: tidal-web
description: TIDAL metadata, search and download provider. Metadata comes from TIDAL's public web endpoints and audio can be downloaded DIRECTLY with your own TIDAL session (Ajustes → Credenciales → TIDAL), sin gateway ni verificación.

qualityOptions.label: Dolby Atmos
qualityOptions.description: Require Dolby Atmos when supported; otherwise fall back only to the best available FLAC tier

qualityOptions.label: HiRes FLAC
qualityOptions.description: Prefer 24-bit Hi-Res FLAC; fall back only to Lossless FLAC when the track is limited to 16-bit

qualityOptions.label: Lossless
qualityOptions.description: Require TIDAL lossless without falling back to a compressed tier

qualityOptions.label: High
qualityOptions.description: Require TIDAL High without falling back to Low

settings.label: Public Web Token
settings.description: Public TIDAL web token used for metadata/search requests.

settings.label: Country Code
settings.description: Country code sent to TIDAL public endpoints.

settings.label: Locale
settings.description: Locale sent to TIDAL public endpoints.

settings.label: Device Type
settings.description: Device type sent to TIDAL public endpoints.
